{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_017XFzja17dgpq7gwa1TNhz3","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /app/sol.sql (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"6891f74a-716a-4d9c-b80e-706da7ca6b30","uuid":"878eebb5-8178-4f3c-9065-6c9e750b1282","timestamp":"2026-05-18T03:17:49.115Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"create","filePath":"/app/sol.sql","content":"WITH senses_synsets AS (\n  SELECT s.wordid, s.synsetid, syn.domainid, syn.posid\n  FROM senses s\n  JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid\n),\nword_stats AS (\n  SELECT\n    wordid,\n    COUNT(DISTINCT synsetid) AS total_synsets,\n    COUNT(*) AS total_senses,\n    COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) AS distinct_domains,\n    COUNT(DISTINCT posid) AS distinct_posids\n  FROM senses_synsets\n  GROUP BY wordid\n  HAVING total_synsets >= 2\n    AND distinct_domains >= 2\n    AND total_senses >= 2\n),\nword_synset_counts AS (\n  SELECT s.wordid, s.synsetid, COUNT(*) AS sense_count\n  FROM senses s\n  JOIN word_stats ws ON s.wordid = ws.wordid\n  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid\n),\nranked_synsets AS (\n  SELECT\n    wordid,\n    synsetid,\n    sense_count,\n    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wordid ORDER BY sense_count DESC, synsetid ASC) AS rn\n  FROM word_synset_counts\n)\nSELECT\n  w.wordid AS word_id,\n  w.word,\n  ws.total_synsets,\n  ws.total_senses,\n  ws.distinct_domains,\n  ws.distinct_posids,\n  rs.synsetid AS top_synsetid,\n  rs.sense_count AS top_synset_sense_count\nFROM word_stats ws\nJOIN words w ON ws.wordid = w.wordid\nJOIN ranked_synsets rs ON ws.wordid = rs.wordid AND rs.rn = 1\nORDER BY\n  ws.total_senses DESC,\n  ws.total_synsets DESC,\n  ws.distinct_domains DESC,\n  w.wordid ASC\nLIMIT 500;\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-4-6","id":"msg_01NQyMgQHn2nHhuicu9p3sz6","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The optimized query runs in **0.35 seconds** vs **2 minutes 22 seconds** — a ~400x speedup.\n\nThe key optimizations in `/app/sol.sql`:\n\n1. **Eliminated correlated subqueries**: The original ran two subqueries into `senses` for *every row* in the outer result (O(n) subquery executions).
